method: Parse original episode JSON. Locate Jonathan Simone in info.TeamNames. Join ACTIVE observation at t-1 to recorded action at t in the same seat. Resolve each context-15 legal option through playerIndex and bench index; compare visible HP and chosen index. Read terminal reward separately. No agent, engine, model or provider executed.
limits: This pass verifies two original recorded choices, not the historical 7,127-action reproduction or entire corpus census.
Policy identity is attributed to the historical verification; these two JSON choices alone do not prove which source bytes executed.
A win or loss after a choice does not establish its causal value or the result of an unchosen action.
Visible HP and legal targeting do not independently prove every damage-prevention interaction. Describe the choices directly rather than guaranteeing a counterfactual knockout.
Original organizer episode files remain local and are not redistributed.
adoption: Use at most a brief worked example contrasting immediate prize pressure with damage placement, explicitly retaining the counterfactual limitation. Do not add a new strength claim.
